settings.heading: If you have always wanted to start with Graphic Design, you’re finally in the right place.
Kick off your Graphic Design career with our 1-Day workshop
What will I be able to do when I'm done?

settings.text:
• Learn the Fundamentals: Understand the basics of video editing, including storytelling, pacing, transitions, and audio synchronization, to create compelling and professional videos. 

• Hands-On with Industry Tools: Get practical experience using popular video editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, , so you can start editing right away. 

• Understand Key Terminologies: Familiarize yourself with essential video editing terms like timelines, keyframes, color grading, and rendering to confidently navigate the editing process. 

•. Build Your First Reel: Leave the workshop with a completed video project to kickstart your portfolio, showcasing your skills to potential clients or employers.

• Market Insights & Trends: Gain valuable insights into the video editing industry, including the rising demand for editors in digital marketing, content creation, and social media.

settings.title: Master the Essentials:
settings.text: Learn the core principles of graphic design, including color theory, typography, composition, and layout, to create visually stunning designs.

settings.title: Get Hands-On with Tools:
settings.text: Gain practical experience with popular graphic design software like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or Canva, ensuring you’re ready to start creating immediately.

settings.title: Understand Key Terminologies:
settings.text: Familiarize yourself with essential video editing terms like timelines, keyframes, color grading, and rendering to confidently navigate the editing process.

settings.title: Understand Industry Jargon:
settings.text: Familiarize yourself with key terms and concepts used in the design world, making you confident in conversations with clients or collaborators.

settings.title: Explore Market Insights:
settings.text: Discover the latest trends, demands, and career opportunities in the graphic design industry, helping you understand how to position yourself as a professional.

settings.title: Build Your Portfolio:
settings.text: Leave the workshop with a completed project to showcase your skills, giving you a head start on building a portfolio for future opportunities.

settings.text: Danah Hany studied Graphic Design at New Giza University and is an El Alsson International School alumna. With experience in branding, packaging, illustration, UI/UX, and social media design, she’s dedicated to inspiring and guiding aspiring designers through practical, hands-on learning.

8 Hours is all it takes! Stop feeling sorry for yourself & start taking some action! Transform your passion into a profession and join the Video Editing 101 Workshop and start your journey to becoming an editor. Limited seats available—secure your spot now!
The entire workshop costs 3000 EGP. A very cheap price in exchange for kicking off your career and what might be your way to financial freedom through freelance/project-based work.
You don’t have to pay the full amount to secure your spot. A refundable 1000 EGP will be sufficient.

settings.heading: Who is this workshop for?
settings.row_content: This workshop is designed for anyone aged 16-30 who wants to kickstart a career in graphic design. No prior experience is needed—just bring your passion and willingness to learn!

settings.heading: Do I need to have studied Graphic Design before?
settings.row_content: No. Danah is going to walk you through the basics and the fundamentals knowing very well that this is your very first interaction ever with graphic design.

settings.heading: What will I need to bring to the workshop?
settings.row_content: Bring your laptop with Adobe Illustrator installed.  Don’t worry if you’re not familiar with the tools, Danah will guide you through everything step by step.

settings.heading: Am I going to receive a certificate?
settings.row_content: Yes, you will be receiving a certificate of completion by the end of the workshop to showcase your newly acquired skills and participation in the workshop.

settings.heading: Will I have access to the instructor and/or my fellow participants?
settings.row_content: Yes, for sure. You will automatically join a community of graphic designers (all at the same phase), so you can exchange experiences and connections. All future graduates of the workshop will be joining the community month in & month out meaning that you will have access to more and more as days go by.

settings.heading: What are the fees for the workshop?
settings.row_content: The fees are 3000 EGP (Totally refundable 3 days before the starting date of the workshop).

settings.heading: Will I be able to complete a full project on my own by the end of the workshop?
settings.row_content: Absolutely! By the end of the workshop, you’ll have a fully created and finalized design that you can include in your portfolio or share with potential clients.
